title: Workshop reservation request
purpose: Capture the requested ability for visitors to reserve a place in a workshop, together with the related undecided aspects.

scope.text: Let visitors reserve a place in a workshop.

requirements.text: Let visitors reserve a place in a workshop.

stories.text: As a visitor, I want to reserve a place in a workshop.
acceptance_criteria: Given an available workshop, when a visitor submits a reservation for a place in that workshop, then the visitor holds a reserved place in that workshop.

risks.text: Because payment, account, capacity-limit and cancellation requirements are undecided, implementation choices made before those decisions may not satisfy the eventual reservation design.

open_questions: Is there a capacity limit for reservations?
Is cancellation part of the reservation behavior?
